title: Zindaan Me Aye Bali Sakina Guzar Gayi
body:
Zindaan mein haye baali Sakina guzar gayi
Asghar ke dil ke saath Sakina ka dil gaya, Abbas kya gaye ke zamana badal gaya, gauhar chhine tamanche lage kurta jal gaya, Noor-e-nazar Hussain ki yon dar badar gayi
Hogi rehayi kab meri zindaane Shaam se, faryaad iski thi ye h i aali muqaam se, dil doobta hai shimre sitamgar ke naam se, dukh sehte sehte haye Sakina bhi margayi
Bhoola na jayega kabhi bibi tera sukhan, bazo khulyenge aur ye khul jayegi gi rasan, ab chhoot kar ye aal-e-nabi jayengi watan, is kamsini mein kitna bada kam kargayi
Bibi Sakina karti hain Zainab se ye fughaan, hoan pyaas se nidhaal to ankhon mein hai dhuwaan, dhoondon batao kis tarha mein baap ko kahan, zalim dhikhayi dete hain mujh ko jidhar gayi
Dil mein khyale Akbar-o-Asghar liye hue, palkon pe aansowaon ka samandar liye hue, Iqbal dil pe daag bahanttar liye hue, maaninde Noor qhaide sitam mein bikhar gayi
